text: A 2008 study of traditional zabady (Int. J. Food Microbiol.) found S. thermophilus dominant, then lactococci, with lactobacilli a minor part, and Lb. johnsonii found for the first time, so the home-made kind is less lactobacillus-driven than the textbook pair. The process figures come from an early-1980s UNIDO report.
